js/content.js needed no changes — all five tasks were scoped to index.html only. The work is done. Here's my report:

## Summary

**Task 1 — Credits accordions:** Replaced the two `.credit-group` cards with three `<details>`/`<summary>` accordions (native, no JS needed): Audio (open by default, since it's the primary content), Tools, Code & type. Audio's three tracks (Dawn/Embrace/Awake) are each nested `<details>` inside the list so only the song name shows until clicked. Every credit/link/licence line was preserved verbatim — nothing dropped, just reorganized (Solar Pop Studio + Claude Code + Three.js + Lenis → Tools; fonts → Code & type).

**Task 2 — About containers:** Audited `sheet-grid`, `toolbox`, `hobbies`, and `site-facts` — none had fixed-height wrappers or non-scrolling containers; `.sheet__body` already scrolls. The one real markup gap was the 6 About-page tiles, where `<b>`/`<small>` sat directly in the grid cell against a `.tile::after` corner icon with only `padding-right` on `<small>` — I wrapped both in `<span class="tile__text">` so CSS can control icon clearance without relying on padding tricks. **Left for CSS:** verify `.site-figure svg` (fixed viewBox diagrams) doesn't visually overlap at narrow sheet widths, and check `.site-facts` grid column min-width on small screens — markup there is already sound.

**Task 3:** Removed the redundant `.btn--ghost` "Read cool news" button from `.hero__cta` (flex row, not grid — losing one child doesn't break layout). Kept the agenda tile.

**Task 4 — Experience nav button:** Added `<button class="experience-toggle" data-experience-toggle data-mode="chaotic" aria-pressed="false">` as a sibling of `.sound-toggle`.

**Task 5 / Experience removal from dropdown — blocked, not done:** I checked, and the Sound dropdown markup does **not live in index.html** — it's built entirely at runtime in `js/sound.js` (`menu.innerHTML = ...` around line 586), which I'm not permitted to edit. So I could not remove the Experience block from the dropdown or add the volume sliders. This needs the sound.js owner to act on the contract below.

### New classes/ids (for CSS agent)
`credits--accordion`, `credit-acc` (+ `--audio`/`--tools`/`--code`), `credit-acc__summary`, `credit-acc__title` (h3, ids `credits-audio`/`credits-tools`/`credits-code`), `credit-acc__chevron`, `credit-acc__body`, `credit__track`, `credit__track-summary`, `tile__text`, `experience-toggle`, `experience-toggle__icon`, `experience-toggle__label`. Reused existing `credit-group__icon`, `credit-list`, `credit-rows`, `credit`, `credit__meta`, `credit__song`.

### Contracts for other agents
- **JS (main.js or wherever nav buttons are wired):** on load, read `Mode.value`/`document.documentElement.dataset.mode` and paint `.experience-toggle`'s `data-mode`, `aria-pressed`, and `.experience-toggle__label` text; on click call `Mode.set(other)`; listen for the existing `modechange` event to stay in sync.
- **sound.js owner (blocking, out of my scope):** remove the `.sound-menu__mode` block (Music/Effects/Experience dropdown, lines ~596-602) since Experience now lives in the nav; add two range sliders in its place — `<input type="range" min="0" max="100" id="vol-music" class="vol-slider" aria-label="Music volume">` + `<input ... id="vol-vfx" class="vol-slider" aria-label="Effects volume">`, each with a `<label>` and a visible value readout.

### Risks
- Credits: default-open Audio section is taller than the old cards — confirm CSS gives `.credit-acc__body` a max-height/scroll or the section doesn't grow unbounded.
- Nothing else touches `data-sheet`, `data-goto`, `data-rot`, or other ids/attributes other scripts query — verified via grep against main.js/content.js/sound.js before editing.
- HTML re-validated with Python's parser after all edits — parses clean.
